part.pin.title: Pin
part.pin.summary: A piece stuck in front of the king cannot move; in front of a bigger piece, it moves at a high price. Attack the pinned piece again.
ex.pin.v18W3: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.v18W3.hint: Look for a black piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.v18W3.solution: 17.Ng6#! The knight gives check on g6, and the pawn on h7 cannot capture it: the queen on h5 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.69GPY: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.69GPY.hint: Look for a white piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.69GPY.solution: 38...Ra1#! The rook gives check on the first rank, and the rook on f2 cannot block on f1: the bishop on b6 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.jhCCp: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.jhCCp.hint: Look for a black piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.jhCCp.solution: 16.Re8#! The rook gives check on the eighth rank, and the rook on f7 cannot block on f8: the bishop on c4 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.39Eek: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.39Eek.hint: Look for a white piece pinned to the king: it can neither capture nor block.
ex.pin.39Eek.solution: 28...Nf3#! The knight gives check on f3, and the pawn on g2 cannot capture it: the rook on g7 pins it to the king.
ex.pin.nUFfh: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.nUFfh.hint: Look for a white piece you can pin to the king.
ex.pin.nUFfh.solution: 15...Bf5! The bishop pins the queen on e4 to the king on b1. After 16.Qxf5, 16...gxf5 recaptures: Black wins the queen for a bishop.
ex.pin.HYQzi: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.HYQzi.hint: Look for a black piece you can pin to the king.
ex.pin.HYQzi.solution: 22.Bc4! The bishop pins the rook on d5 to the king on g8, and your queen also attacks it along the d-file. The rook cannot leave the diagonal. After 22...b5, 23.Bxd5+ captures the rook: White wins the rook for a bishop.
ex.pin.5MC0G: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.5MC0G.hint: See what stands behind the pawn on e4, on your rook's file.
ex.pin.5MC0G.solution: 17.Qxf3! The pawn on e4 is pinned by the rook on e1 to the queen on e5: if it recaptures, the queen falls. After 17...exf3 18.Rxe5 Nxe5, 19.Bxd5+ captures the knight, which lost the queen that defended it: White is a piece up.
ex.pin.M8uTb: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.pin.M8uTb.hint: Look for a white piece you can pin to the king.
ex.pin.M8uTb.solution: 13...Bh6! The bishop pins the queen on f4 to the king on c1. After 14.Qxh6, 14...Rxh6 recaptures: Black wins the queen for a bishop.
ex.pin.TAKy2: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.pin.TAKy2.hint: Look for a check that forces the black queen to stop on her king's file. There, she can be pinned.
ex.pin.TAKy2.solution: 30.Rxg6+! The rook captures the knight with check and also attacks the queen on f6: it is a fork. If the king moves or takes the rook, White mates; so 30...Qxg6. Now the queen stands on the king's file, and 31.Rg1! pins her: attacked by the rook and by the queen on e6, she cannot leave the g-file. After 31...Qxg1+ 32.Kxg1, White has given both rooks and kept the queen and the knight.
part.skewer.title: Skewer
part.skewer.summary: Attack the more valuable piece on the line: it moves, and the one behind falls. It is the pin reversed; before the check, see what stands behind the king.
ex.skewer.sbkwY: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.skewer.sbkwY.hint: Look for a check with a black piece behind the king, on the same line.
ex.skewer.sbkwY.solution: 41.Bc8+! The bishop gives check on c8, and behind the king, on the same diagonal, stands the knight on h3. After 41...Ke5, 42.Bxh3 captures the knight.
ex.skewer.8XbPd: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.skewer.8XbPd.hint: Look for a check with a white piece behind the king, on the same line.
ex.skewer.8XbPd.solution: 38...Rh2+! The rook gives check on the second rank, and behind the king stands the queen on c2. After 39.Ke3, 39...Rxc2 captures the queen.
ex.skewer.7TWnJ: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.skewer.7TWnJ.hint: Look for a check with a black piece behind the king, on the same line.
ex.skewer.7TWnJ.solution: 71.Rg8+! The rook gives check on the g-file, and behind the king stands the rook on g1. After 71...Kf7, 72.Rxg1 captures the rook.
ex.skewer.j45Ex: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.skewer.j45Ex.hint: Look for a check with a white piece behind the king, on the same line.
ex.skewer.j45Ex.solution: 63...Qg1+! The queen gives check on the g-file, and behind the king stands the queen on g8. After 64.Kf5, 64...Qxg8 captures the queen.
ex.skewer.L2zwp: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.skewer.L2zwp.hint: Look for two black pieces on the same line, the more valuable one in front.
ex.skewer.L2zwp.solution: 14.Bf4! The bishop attacks the queen on e5, and behind it, on the same diagonal, stands the bishop on d6. After 14...Qf6, 15.Bxd6 captures the bishop.
ex.skewer.4MJX7: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.skewer.4MJX7.hint: Your queen is attacked by the rook. Look for an escape with check that leaves a piece exposed behind the king.
ex.skewer.4MJX7.solution: 30...Qh2+! The queen escapes the rook's attack with check, and behind the king, on the second rank, stands the queen on a2. After 31.Ke1, 31...Qxa2 captures the queen.
ex.skewer.JOBEC: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.skewer.JOBEC.hint: Look for a check with a white piece behind the king, on the same line.
ex.skewer.JOBEC.solution: 46...Bb1+! The bishop gives check on b1, and behind the king, on the same diagonal, stands the rook on f5. After 47.Kc4, 47...Bxf5 captures the rook.
ex.skewer.KVfyU: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.skewer.KVfyU.hint: Look for a check with a white piece behind the king, and see which white piece is pinned.
ex.skewer.KVfyU.solution: 39...Rb8+! The rook gives check on the b-file, and behind the king stands the rook on b1. The knight on c6 cannot capture on b8: the bishop on d7 pins it to the king. After 40.Kc5, 40...Rxb1 captures the rook.
ex.skewer.N9PM1: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.skewer.N9PM1.hint: The white queen is pinned to the king. Look for a capture that attacks the queen and the piece behind it.
ex.skewer.N9PM1.solution: 30...Rxd6! The rook attacks the queen on d4, pinned by the queen on b6 to the king, and through it the rook on d1. After 31.Qxb6 Rxd1+ 32.Kf2 axb6, Black is a knight up.
part.discoveredAttack.title: Discovered attack
part.discoveredAttack.summary: Move the front piece with a threat: the line opens, and the one behind attacks. First, see whether the attacked piece can capture the one that moved.
ex.discoveredAttack.pMe9U: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.pMe9U.hint: See what your rook on d1 would meet if the d-file opened.
ex.discoveredAttack.pMe9U.solution: 34.Bxf7+! The bishop captures the pawn on f7 with check and opens the d-file: the rook on d1 attacks the queen on d6. After 34...Kxf7, 35.Rxd6 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.nitC8: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.nitC8.hint: See what your queen on d8 would meet if the d-file opened.
ex.discoveredAttack.nitC8.solution: 17...Bxh2+! The bishop captures the pawn on h2 with check and opens the d-file: the queen on d8 attacks the queen on d4. After 18.Kxh2, 18...Qxd4 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.uCdrn: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.uCdrn.hint: The white queen stands on the e-file. Which of your pieces blocks that file?
ex.discoveredAttack.uCdrn.solution: 26...Bxg5+! The bishop captures the pawn on g5 with check and opens the e-file: the rook on e8 attacks the queen on e4. After 27.hxg5, 27...Rxe4 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.MEcMu: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.MEcMu.hint: See what your queen on e7 would meet if the diagonal opened.
ex.discoveredAttack.MEcMu.solution: 43.Rxh6+! The rook captures the pawn on h6 with check and opens the diagonal from the queen on e7 to the queen on c5. After 43...gxh6, 44.Qxc5 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.f4MCM: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.f4MCM.hint: See what your rook on e8 would meet if the eighth rank opened.
ex.discoveredAttack.f4MCM.solution: 28...Bg4+! The bishop gives check on g4 and opens the eighth rank: the rook on e8 attacks the rook on a8. After 29.Ke1, 29...Rxa8 captures the rook.
ex.discoveredAttack.qwxrc: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.qwxrc.hint: The black queen on h5 and your queen on f3 stand on the same diagonal. What stands between them?
ex.discoveredAttack.qwxrc.solution: 26.Nf6+! The knight gives check on f6 and opens the diagonal from the queen on f3 to the queen on h5. After 26...Bxf6, 27.Qxh5 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.RBGga: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.RBGga.hint: Look for a check by the front piece, and see which black piece is pinned.
ex.discoveredAttack.RBGga.solution: 24.Nxe6+! The knight captures the pawn on e6 with check and opens the diagonal from the queen on f2 to the queen on b6. The pawn on f7 cannot capture on e6: the queen on f2 pins it to the king. After 24...Kg8, 25.Qxb6 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.w5vB6: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.w5vB6.hint: Both queens stand on the d-file. Which of your pieces stands between them, and where can it go with a threat?
ex.discoveredAttack.w5vB6.solution: 11.Bxb5+! The bishop captures the pawn on b5 with check and opens the d-file: the queen on d1 attacks the queen on d4. After 11...axb5, 12.Qxd4 captures the queen.
ex.discoveredAttack.Oo4l7: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.discoveredAttack.Oo4l7.hint: Look for a check by the front piece, and see which black piece is pinned.
ex.discoveredAttack.Oo4l7.solution: 20.Nh6+! The knight gives check on h6 and opens the diagonal from the queen on g4 to the queen on d7. The pawn on g7 cannot capture on h6: the queen on g4 pins it to the king. After 20...Kh8, 21.Qxd7 captures the queen.
ex.t2.6d5fl: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.t2.6d5fl.hint: Look for a line that runs through two of the opponent's pieces and check what the front one can no longer do.
ex.t2.6d5fl.solution: 16...Bc5! The bishop pins the queen on d4 to the king on g1. After 17.Qxc5, 17...Rxc5 recaptures: Black wins the queen for a bishop.
ex.t2.PYKb0: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.t2.PYKb0.hint: Check what stands behind each of the opponent's pieces, on the same line.
ex.t2.PYKb0.solution: 55...Bc1+! The bishop checks from c1, and behind the king, on the same diagonal, stands the rook on g5. After 56.Kf2, 56...Bxg5 captures the rook.
ex.t2.aTbeB: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.aTbeB.hint: Before choosing the square, check whether the attacked piece can capture the one you move.
ex.t2.aTbeB.solution: 12.Nd6+! The knight checks from d6 and opens the diagonal of the bishop on f1 to the queen on b5. On a5 or b6, the queen would capture the knight and leave the diagonal. After 12...Bxd6, 13.Bxb5 captures the queen.
ex.t2.zIlsI: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.zIlsI.hint: Check what stands behind each of the opponent's pieces, on the same line.
ex.t2.zIlsI.solution: 22.Rd1! The rook attacks the queen on d4, and behind it, on the d-file, stands the bishop on d7. After 22...Qf4, 23.Rxd7 captures the bishop.
ex.t2.YdQQV: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.YdQQV.hint: Look for the moves that create two threats at once and check whether the opponent can save both.
ex.t2.YdQQV.solution: 49.Ng5+! The knight checks the king on h7 and attacks the queen on f7. The h6-pawn cannot capture it: the queen on h4 pins it to the king. After 49...Kg7, 50.Nxf7 captures the queen.
ex.t2.3zdYz: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.3zdYz.hint: See which of your pieces stands behind another of yours and what it attacks when the front one moves.
ex.t2.3zdYz.solution: 29.Ng6+! The knight checks from g6 and opens the diagonal of the queen on f4 to the queen on d6. The f7-pawn cannot capture on g6: the queen on f4 pins it to the king. After 29...Kg8, 30.Qxd6 captures the queen.
ex.t2.4boVF: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.4boVF.hint: Look for a line that runs through two of the opponent's pieces and check what the front one can no longer do.
ex.t2.4boVF.solution: 38.Qxd8+! captures the hanging knight on d8 with check. After 38...Kh7, 39.Bb1! pins the queen on d3 to the king, on the diagonal from b1 to h7. The queen can only move along that diagonal, and the knight on d2 defends the bishop: White wins the queen for a bishop.
ex.t2.tNS9G: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.t2.tNS9G.hint: Check what stands behind each of the opponent's pieces, on the same line.
ex.t2.tNS9G.solution: 61...Qd3+! Of all the queen checks, this is the one with a piece behind the king: on the d-file, past the king on d5, stands the queen on d8. After 62.Kc5, 62...Qxd8 captures the queen.
ex.t2.H2NAI: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.H2NAI.hint: Look for a line that runs through two of the opponent's pieces and check what the front one can no longer do.
ex.t2.H2NAI.solution: 14.Bf6! The bishop opens the g-file: the queen on g4 threatens 15.Qxg7, with mate, and the bishop on g7, pinned to the king, cannot capture on f6. Only the knight on e7 can defend g7, with 14...Ng6 or 14...Nf5, but it is pinned to the queen on d8: if it leaves, Black loses the queen. After 14...Ng6, 15.Bxd8 captures the queen.
ex.t2.2GnQ8: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.t2.2GnQ8.hint: Look for the moves that create two threats at once and check whether the opponent can save both.
ex.t2.2GnQ8.solution: 32...Nc2+! The knight checks from c2, attacks the rook on e1 and opens the e-file: the rook on e8 attacks the rook on e1 as well. After 33.Bxc2, which captures the knight, 33...Rxe1+ captures the rook with check.
ex.t2.qPH5H: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.t2.qPH5H.hint: Check what stands behind each of the opponent's pieces, on the same line.
ex.t2.qPH5H.solution: 21.Rd5+! The rook checks along the d-file, and behind the king, on the same file, stands the queen on d8. The knight on e7 could capture the rook, but the queen on g7 pins it to the king along the seventh rank. After 21...Ke6, 22.Rxd8 captures the queen.
ex.t2.kOhoa: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.t2.kOhoa.hint: Look for the moves that create two threats at once and check whether the opponent can save both.
ex.t2.kOhoa.solution: 27...Nf3+! The knight checks from f3, attacks the rook on d2 and opens the d-file: the rook on d7 attacks the rook on d2 as well. After 28.Bxf3, which captures the knight, 28...Rxd2 captures the rook.
